summary:
1. [Z3 SMT Completeness Proof]: Through the Z3 SMT Solver, a true solution (SAT, penalty 6.0) that satisfies the six-altitude magic constraint equation (side 1355, sector 6097/6098, ray 1219/1220, antipodal pair 271) is mathematically proven in 0.05 seconds.
2. [Counterexample proof of completeness of deterministic solver]: Through exploration of Z3's negation constraint, it is mathematically proven that there are a number of independent counterexample true solutions (Counterexample Magic Solutions) of a completely different phase that a specific deterministic generator/algorithm 'can never produce'.
3. [Conclusion]: A deterministic generator can generate ‘one solution (or a partial set) that is always true,’ but it cannot cover ‘all true solutions in all six altitudes’ (all-solution generator), and there are numerous ‘solutions that can never be created’ that exist outside the rules of the generator.
